# Zydis and Zycore

Stone uses the decoder and encoder from Zydis 4.1.1, commit
`a2278f1d254e492f6a6b39f6cb5d1f5d515659dc`.
The bundled Zycore commit is `0b2432ced0884fd152b471d97ecf0258ff4d859f`.
Both projects use the MIT license. Their original license files are included: [Zydis](../../oss/zydis/LICENSE) and [Zycore](../../oss/zydis/dependencies/zycore/LICENSE).
Trailing whitespace and blank lines at the end of files have been normalized.

Upstream sources are https://github.com/zyantific/zydis and
https://github.com/zyantific/zycore-c.
